choices.design: Five-point product Gauss-Hermite numerical integration of exact Gaussian predictive expected information; deterministic ties choose x1. Only the design integral is approximate; posterior likelihoods are exact.
choices.primary: Four paired-noise transitions after each 4/8-record history, designed versus natural; marginalize gain before scoring perception/reference.
choices.pulse_timing: Known +2 impulse to the observed state before controller response. Record includes perturbed state and next observed state. Natural noise enters after response; reader integrates action and disturbance variance.
choices.readout: Empirical observed state variance / analytical uncontrolled variance including action noise, reader decay .9; tie picks first perception.
choices.truth_roster: all 30 perception/reference/gain hypotheses in every world
